subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should subagent completion announce delivery turns be treated as tool-free relay-only runs that reconcile interrupted parent-topic sessions to non-running state instead of human restart recovery?
rationale: The code appears correct, but this is an intentional session-state and tool-boundary policy decision that affects recovery behavior for existing Telegram/topic sessions.

options.title: Accept relay-only announce semantics
options.body: Merge the PR as-is after accepting that interrupted announce delivery runs are not human turns and should not resume with recovery prompts.

options.title: Change the terminal state first
options.body: Ask for a small follow-up before merge if `status: "killed"` should be a different canonical non-running outcome for aborted announce delivery.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery design
options.body: Keep the PR open only if maintainers want this exact case handled by a larger subagent delivery/session architecture change instead.

recommendation.title: Accept relay-only announce semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the PR as-is after accepting that interrupted announce delivery runs are not human turns and should not resume with recovery prompts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner most directly to restart recovery lifecycle, transcript identity, and Codex internal-turn tool behavior touched by the decision.
